unavailable_fields.memory.peak_allocated_bytes_allocation_c: No available collector supplies per-operation torch caching-allocator bytes or live-tensor sizes at the peak. The already-run torch trace yields kernel attribution only (coverage.json: cuda_kernels=88, associated_kernels=88, unassociated_kernels=0, ambiguous_forward_sequences=0); nsys would show driver-level cudaMalloc/cuMemAlloc events that caching-allocator segment reuse hides and that do not correspond to torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(); device_telemetry reports device-wide NVML memory, not process torch-allocator bytes. Composition was instead derived analytically from the actual assets with the worker Python (/root/autodl-tmp/dev-venv/bin/python, CPU only): 11,689,512 FP32 parameters = 46,758,048 bytes live for the whole invocation; per-call transients dominated by conv1 output 32x64x112x112x4 = 98.0 MiB and layer1 tensors 24.5 MiB each; all 17 ReLU modules are out-of-place (inplace=False), so each currently duplicates its input allocation.
unavailable_fields.memory.reserved_vs_allocated_and_fragmen: No available collector reports caching-allocator segment or fragmentation state. The evaluator metric is peak allocated bytes only (max_memory_allocated after synchronize, reset_peak_memory_stats before each of 5 samples); reserved, driver and whole-GPU memory (device_telemetry's device-wide NVML readings with native windows) are different quantities and cannot be converted into the objective.
unavailable_fields.communication.nccl_algorithm_protocol_ch: Not applicable to this frozen workload: single process on one leased GPU (request.devices has one UUID, distributed_backend null); observations.json records the communication capability as not_applicable 'single-device task'. No NCCL communicator exists, so nccl_tuning's warmed-worker algorithm/protocol/channel capture has no subject, and kernel entry names alone could not identify protocol decisions regardless.
unavailable_fields.communication.pcie_nvlink_wire_bytes: No inter-device or host-device transfer lies inside the measured invocation: the batch-32 FP32 input is GPU-resident before timing (request notes). No collector measures per-operation wire bytes; device_telemetry supplies device-wide NVLink/PCIe rates only as device-wide readings with native sampling windows, and logical payload or memcpy sizes must not be invented as PCIe/NVLink traffic.
unavailable_fields.numerics.first_divergence_site_and_per_s: No available collector compares intermediate tensors, measures per-site numerical error, or locates the first numerical divergence: candidate_diagnostics records only exceptions (including handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations) and False returns in supplied candidate files in a separate instrumented run, and its empty events would not establish which successful path executed. Numerical acceptance remains the evaluator's full 1000-class logits assert_close (atol=rtol=1e-4) plus exact top-1 equality.
unavailable_fields.binding.candidate_binding_overhead: binding_cost is not applicable at this revision: no candidate exists yet (inputs contain only the original source; binding_backend 'legacy'). It applies only once an additive candidate that retains all installed parent bundles exists, and it reports whole-invocation AB/BA cost, not per-group effects. Defer to a revised plan (together with candidate_diagnostics for candidate exceptions) once candidate files exist.

rationale: Frozen objective: minimize process-level peak_allocated_bytes for one batch-32 FP32 inference_mode forward of pretrained ResNet-18 on a single leased RTX 4090, retaining images_per_second >= 0.95 of baseline with full-logits (atol=rtol=1e-4) and exact top-1 quality; workload, provider config and thresholds untouched. Selection: no remaining collector produces decision-relevant evidence for this objective at this revision. (1) torch already ran and its evidence is complete: coverage.json shows 88/88 CUDA kernels associated below the project, 0 unassociated, 0 root-only, 0 autograd ranges and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, so the overlap, graph-tracing and attribution questions that would justify the optional nsys run are already answered; execution is a single-stream eager forward (no CUDA graphs, cudnn.benchmark off), and an nsys timeline cannot observe caching-allocator peak composition in any case. (2) The workload is single-process single-GPU (one device UUID, distributed_backend null; observations.json marks communication not_applicable), so nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and the communication-oriented readings of device_telemetry have no subject; execution_timeline's distinctive value (CPU-submit clock-alignment bounds, comm-hook semantics) targets distributed questions, and its synchronization/per-device-interval data adds nothing beyond the already-complete CPU-to-CUDA association. (3) No candidate exists yet, so binding_cost is explicitly inapplicable before a candidate and candidate_diagnostics has no supplied candidate files to instrument; both are deferred to a later revision rather than run empty. (4) python_runtime is not selected: host dispatch is not the frozen objective, the evaluator already measures clean images_per_second over 5 repeats, and cProfile perturbs execution while its inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations. The memory target is activation/allocation-driven and analytically grounded via CPU inspection on the worker Python: 11,689,512 FP32 parameters (46,758,048 bytes) are always live; conv1 output (98.0 MiB) and layer1 tensors (24.5 MiB each) dominate transients; all 17 ReLUs are out-of-place and duplicate their input allocations, so the candidate levers (in-place ReLU, allocation ordering/lifetime, cudnn workspace policy) are source-level and are validated by the evaluator's own quality checks rather than by any collector in this menu. The objective metric peak_allocated_bytes is the evaluator's clean-sample metric and is deliberately not requested as a collector field. Unobservable dimensions are recorded in unavailable_fields with observed reasons instead of being guessed; no counters were requested indiscriminately.
